definitions.A: Достаточно документирован для подготовки будущей образовательной карточки в историческом национальном объёме; не готовая карточка и не научное одобрение.
definitions.B: Точный нерешённый таксономический/источниковый вопрос; никакого автоматического допуска или замены родительским видом.
definitions.C: Не создаёт самостоятельной допустимой новой карточки. Один подтверждённый дубликат учитывается среди 52 пробелов имён; 17 исключённых номеров считаются отдельно как строки документа.
definitions.acceptedName: Для A предпочтительное принятое имя сохранённого GBIF-свидетельства; альтернативные гомотипные комбинации других источников сохранены. Для B поле null, предложения базы — только в taxonomyEvidence.
definitions.maximum: Условные ограничения, не обещание достигнуть 200 и не число готовых карточек.

Hedlundia persica accepted; Sorbus persica is a homotypic synonym. Kyrgyzstan is included in the distribution.
Prunus petunnikowii accepted; Amygdalus petunnikowii is a homotypic synonym. Kyrgyzstan is included.

additionalScientificSources.finding: Type of Kosopoljanskia hebecarpa catalogued under accepted Schrenkia hebecarpa; country Kyrgyzstan. Used only for identity, not photograph preparation.

additionalScientificSources.publisher: Plant Diversity of Central Asia 1 (2022), 21–51; University of Helsinki repository
additionalScientificSources.finding: Page 43 gives the homotypic combination Schrenkia turkestanica = Kosopoljanskia turkestanica and distribution including Talas, Kyrgyzstan.

additionalScientificSources.publisher: Sennikov, Lazkov, Uotila & Weber, Taxonomic corrections and new records in vascular plants of Kyrgyzstan (2011)
additionalScientificSources.finding: Documents Eriophyton anomalum as a new combination from Erianthera anomala, discusses the former Alajja concepts and Kyrgyz specimens. No extra taxon is created for the alternative genera.

Moluccella olgae accepted, with Otostegia schennikovii a heterotypic synonym. The accepted range includes Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan. A future card must restrict historical descriptions to the national named concept.

Salvia vvedenskii Nikitina accepted; original publication Flora Kirgizskoi SSR 10:377 (1962), range Kyrgyzstan. National Salvia vvedenskyi E. Nikit. is reconciled by the same author and a subsequent exact GBIF query, not by fuzzy matching alone.

Rhaponticum aulieatense accepted by POWO; Leuzea aulieatensis and Stemmacantha aulieatensis are homotypic alternatives. GBIF chooses Leuzea; the genus preference differs but the named species and rank are linked explicitly. The national account itself gives Rhaponticum as an alternative.
Richteria leontopodium accepted; Pyrethrum leontopodium a homotypic synonym; distribution includes Kyrgyzstan.

Dorema microcarpum is a homotypic synonym of Ferula namanganica in POWO, whereas the GBIF response chooses Ferula microcarpum. POWO lists Uzbekistan only. Preferred valid name, GBIF linkage and the national geographic concept need a combined review; retained in B.

additionalScientificSources.publisher: American Society of Mammalogists; Mammal Diversity Database
additionalScientificSources.finding: Rhinolophus hipposideros previously included R. midas; current authorship is André 1797 rather than the commonly cited Bechstein dates. Exact GBIF spelling alone cannot settle the national account's Iran–Turan subspecies concept.

additionalScientificSources.publisher: American Society of Mammalogists; Mammal Diversity Database
additionalScientificSources.finding: Rhinolophus midas is split from R. hipposideros, with Iran and Oman in its country list; cites Benda et al. 2023, DOI 10.3161/15081109ACC2022.24.2.001. No automatic transfer of Kyrgyz records to either species.
